chapterInfo.content:
11
Osuboni Yohane ahoyera
(Luka 7.18-35)
1Na ɛbaa sɛ Yesu wiee n’asuafoɔ dummienu no kasakyerɛ no, ɔfirii hɔ sɛ ɔrekɔkyerɛkyerɛ na waka asɛm wɔn nkuro mu. 2#Mat 14.3 Na Yohane tee Kristo nnwuma wɔ afiase no, ɔsomaa n’asuafoɔ 3#Mal 3.1 kɔbisaa no sɛ: Wone deɛ ɔreba no, anaasɛ yɛnhwɛ ɔfoforɔ kwan? 4Na Yesu bua see wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ, na monkɔka deɛ moteɛ na mohunu yi nkyerɛ Yohane: 5#Yes 35.3-6; 61.1 Anifirafoɔ hunu adeɛ, na mmubuafoɔ nante, akwatafoɔ ho fi, na asotifoɔ te asɛm, awufoɔ nyane, na wɔka asɛmpa kyerɛ ahiafoɔ. 6#Mat 13.57; 26.31 Na nhyira ne deɛ merento no suntidua.
Yesu di Yohane ho adanseɛ
7 # Mat 3.1; 3.5 Na yeinom rekorɔ no, Yesu firii aseɛ kaa Yohane ho asɛm kyerɛɛ nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na mofirii adi kɔɔ serɛ so kɔhwɛeɛ? Mmɛwa a mframa rehim anaa? 8Anaasɛ ɛdeɛn na mofirii adi kɔhwɛeɛ? Onipa a ɔhyɛ ntadeɛ bɔkɔɔ anaa? Hwɛ, wɔn a wɔhyɛ ntadeɛ bɔkɔɔ no wɔ ahemfo afie mu. 9#Luka 1.76 Anaasɛ adɛn nti na mofirii adie? Mokɔhwɛɛ odiyifoɔ anaa? Aane, mese mo sɛ, ɔsene odiyifoɔ mpo. 10#Mal 3.1 Oyi ne deɛ wɔatwerɛ ne ho asɛm sɛ:
Hwɛ, meresoma me bɔfoɔ adi w’anim
a ɔbɛsiesie w’anim kwan.
11 # Mat 13.17 Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, wɔn a mmaa awo wɔn nyinaa mu biara nsɔree a ɔsene Yohane suboni; nanso deɛ ɔyɛ ketewa koraa wɔ ɔsoro ahennie mu no yɛ kɛseɛ sene no. 12#Luka 16.16; 13.24 Na ɛfiri Osuboni Yohane berɛ so bɛsi nnɛ wɔyɛ ɔsoro ahennie no ho adeɛ anibereɛ so, na wɔn a wɔn ani abereɛ no fa no aniɛden so. 13Na adiyifoɔ no nyinaa ne mmara no hyɛɛ nkɔm bɛsii Yohane so. 14#Mal 4.5; Mat 17.10-13 Na sɛ mopɛ sɛ mogye a, oyi ne Elia a ɔreba no. 15Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no, ma no ntie!
Yudafoɔ akomapirim
16 Na hwan ho na mede nnɛ mma yi bɛtoɔ? Wɔte sɛ mmɔfra a wɔtete edwa ase refrɛfrɛ wɔn mfɛfoɔ sɛ:
17 # Mmb 29.9 Yɛahyɛne atɛntɛbɛn ama mo na moansa;
yɛatwa agyaadwo ama mo, na mo werɛ anho.
18 # Mat 3.4 Na Yohane baeɛ, ɔnnidi na ɔnnom, na wɔse: Ɔwɔ honhommɔne. 19#Mat 9.14-15 Onipa ba no baeɛ, ɔdidi na ɔnom, na wɔse: Hwɛ, odidifoɔ ne ɔsanomfoɔ, togyefoɔ ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ adamfo. Nanso, nyansa nam ne nnwuma so di bem.
Korasin, Betsaida ne Kapernaum
(Luka 10.12-15)
20Ɛnna ɔfirii aseɛ kaa nkuro a na wayɛ ne tumideɛ pii wom no anim sɛ wɔannsakyera wɔn adwene no sɛ: 21#Yona 3.6 Korasin, due! Betsaida, due! Ɛfiri sɛ tumideɛ a wɔayɛ no mo mu yi, sɛ wɔyɛɛ no Tiro ne Sidon a, anka wɔasakyera wɔn adwene ayitoma ne nso mu dada. 22Nso mese mo sɛ, atemmuda no, ɛbɛfanyinam Tiro ne Sidon asene mo. 23#Mat 4.13; 8.5; 9.1 Na wo Kapernaum,
wɔbɛma wo so akɔ soro anaa?
Hwɛ, wɔbɛbrɛ wo ase akɔ Asamando;
ɛfiri sɛ tumideɛ a wɔayɛ no wo mu yi, sɛ wɔyɛɛ no Sodom a, anka ɛwɔ hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ. 24#Mat 10.15 Nso mese mo sɛ, atemmuda no, ɛbɛfanyinam Sodom asase asene wo.
Agya no ayeyie
(Luka 10.21-22)
25 # 1 Ko 1.26-29 Saa berɛ no ara mu Yesu kaa sɛ: Agya, ɔsoro ne asase wura, meyi wo ayɛ sɛ wode nnoɔma yi ahunta anyansafoɔ ne animdefoɔ, na woayi akyerɛ nkɔkoaa. 26Aane, Agya, saa na ɛyɛ anisɔ w’anim. 27#Mat 28.18; Yoh 3.35; 17.2; Flp 2.9 M’agya de nnoɔma nyinaa ahyɛ me nsa; na obiara nnim Ɔba no, gye Agya no, na obiara nnim Agya no, gye Ɔba no ne deɛ Ɔba no pɛ sɛ ɔyi no adi kyerɛ no. 28#Mat 12.20; Yer 31.25 Mo a moayɛ adwuma abrɛ na wɔasoa mo nnesoa nyinaa, mommra me nkyɛn, na mɛma mo ahome. 29Momfa me kɔnnua nto mo ho so, na monsua me, ɛfiri sɛ medwo na mebrɛ me ho ase akoma mu; na mobɛnya ɔhome ama mo kra. 30#1 Yoh 5.3 Na me kɔnnua yɛ mmerɛ, na m’adesoa yɛ hare.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na ɛbaa sɛ Yesu wiee n’asuafoɔ dummienu no kasakyerɛ no, ɔfirii hɔ sɛ ɔrekɔkyerɛkyerɛ na waka asɛm wɔn nkuro mu. Na Yohane tee Kristo nnwuma wɔ afiase no, ɔsomaa n’asuafoɔ kɔbisaa no sɛ: Wone deɛ ɔreba no, anaasɛ yɛnhwɛ ɔfoforɔ kwan? Na Yesu bua see wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ, na monkɔka deɛ moteɛ na mohunu yi nkyerɛ Yohane: Anifirafoɔ hunu adeɛ, na mmubuafoɔ nante, akwatafoɔ ho fi, na asotifoɔ te asɛm, awufoɔ nyane, na wɔka asɛmpa kyerɛ ahiafoɔ. Na nhyira ne deɛ merento no suntidua.

Na yeinom rekorɔ no, Yesu firii aseɛ kaa Yohane ho asɛm kyerɛɛ nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na mofirii adi kɔɔ serɛ so kɔhwɛeɛ? Mmɛwa a mframa rehim anaa? Anaasɛ ɛdeɛn na mofirii adi kɔhwɛeɛ? Onipa a ɔhyɛ ntadeɛ bɔkɔɔ anaa? Hwɛ, wɔn a wɔhyɛ ntadeɛ bɔkɔɔ no wɔ ahemfo afie mu. Anaasɛ adɛn nti na mofirii adie? Mokɔhwɛɛ odiyifoɔ anaa? Aane, mese mo sɛ, ɔsene odiyifoɔ mpo. Oyi ne deɛ wɔatwerɛ ne ho asɛm sɛ:
Hwɛ, meresoma me bɔfoɔ adi w’anim
a ɔbɛsiesie w’anim kwan.
Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, wɔn a mmaa awo wɔn nyinaa mu biara nsɔree a ɔsene Yohane suboni; nanso deɛ ɔyɛ ketewa koraa wɔ ɔsoro ahennie mu no yɛ kɛseɛ sene no. Na ɛfiri Osuboni Yohane berɛ so bɛsi nnɛ wɔyɛ ɔsoro ahennie no ho adeɛ anibereɛ so, na wɔn a wɔn ani abereɛ no fa no aniɛden so. Na adiyifoɔ no nyinaa ne mmara no hyɛɛ nkɔm bɛsii Yohane so. Na sɛ mopɛ sɛ mogye a, oyi ne Elia a ɔreba no. Deɛ ɔwɔ aso no, ma no ntie!

Na hwan ho na mede nnɛ mma yi bɛtoɔ? Wɔte sɛ mmɔfra a wɔtete edwa ase refrɛfrɛ wɔn mfɛfoɔ sɛ:
Yɛahyɛne atɛntɛbɛn ama mo na moansa;
yɛatwa agyaadwo ama mo, na mo werɛ anho.
Na Yohane baeɛ, ɔnnidi na ɔnnom, na wɔse: Ɔwɔ honhommɔne. Onipa ba no baeɛ, ɔdidi na ɔnom, na wɔse: Hwɛ, odidifoɔ ne ɔsanomfoɔ, togyefoɔ ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ adamfo. Nanso, nyansa nam ne nnwuma so di bem.


Ɛnna ɔfirii aseɛ kaa nkuro a na wayɛ ne tumideɛ pii wom no anim sɛ wɔannsakyera wɔn adwene no sɛ: Korasin, due! Betsaida, due! Ɛfiri sɛ tumideɛ a wɔayɛ no mo mu yi, sɛ wɔyɛɛ no Tiro ne Sidon a, anka wɔasakyera wɔn adwene ayitoma ne nso mu dada. Nso mese mo sɛ, atemmuda no, ɛbɛfanyinam Tiro ne Sidon asene mo. Na wo Kapernaum,
wɔbɛma wo so akɔ soro anaa?
Hwɛ, wɔbɛbrɛ wo ase akɔ Asamando;
ɛfiri sɛ tumideɛ a wɔayɛ no wo mu yi, sɛ wɔyɛɛ no Sodom a, anka ɛwɔ hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ. Nso mese mo sɛ, atemmuda no, ɛbɛfanyinam Sodom asase asene wo.


Saa berɛ no ara mu Yesu kaa sɛ: Agya, ɔsoro ne asase wura, meyi wo ayɛ sɛ wode nnoɔma yi ahunta anyansafoɔ ne animdefoɔ, na woayi akyerɛ nkɔkoaa. Aane, Agya, saa na ɛyɛ anisɔ w’anim. M’agya de nnoɔma nyinaa ahyɛ me nsa; na obiara nnim Ɔba no, gye Agya no, na obiara nnim Agya no, gye Ɔba no ne deɛ Ɔba no pɛ sɛ ɔyi no adi kyerɛ no. Mo a moayɛ adwuma abrɛ na wɔasoa mo nnesoa nyinaa, mommra me nkyɛn, na mɛma mo ahome. Momfa me kɔnnua nto mo ho so, na monsua me, ɛfiri sɛ medwo na mebrɛ me ho ase akoma mu; na mobɛnya ɔhome ama mo kra. Na me kɔnnua yɛ mmerɛ, na m’adesoa yɛ hare.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
